name: Joseph John Meier

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Mary Agatha Lyons (1907 – 31 Oct 1999), widow of Joseph Francis Moore (1902–1945) and mother of James John Moore (1926–2000).

bioAdditions: FamilySearch has Joseph's later life (S1). After 1940 he married Mary Agatha Lyons, the widow of Joseph Francis Moore, who had died in 1945, so the marriage was after 1945. He lived at Merchantville, New Jersey, by 1957. He died in Philadelphia on 16 Feb 1970 and was buried at St Mary's, Hanover Twp. His wife died in 1999 and was buried there too.
